verdict.rationale: RingCentral ships AI features (AI Receptionist, Conversational Intelligence, an Agentic Voice AI platform), so an opt-out from AI model training is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting, policy, or contractual commitment that prevents customer data from being used for training. App permission scopes are a different control and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
